description: Written by each active dev session to report its current state. The session_orchestrator.py reads this file to build the dashboard.

sessions.name: string — matches a name in SESSIONS.json
sessions.last_active: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — update this every time the session does work
sessions.current_task: string — what the session is doing right now
sessions.next_task: string — what the session will do after current_task
